S.2, Special Branch Section,
REPORT
Date February 9, 1934.
Subject (in full) Publishers' Union Ltd., 54/6 Nanking Road -
seizure of Communistic Literature.
Made by D.S. Sansom Forwarded by O.J. Burnett

With reference to the attached report of D.S. Wilcox,
bearing on the above mentioned subject, I have to report that
a co-director of the Publishers' Union Ltd., named K. W. Pao
(包可華), residing at No.6, Passage 38, Rue Victor Emmanuel,
returned to the Union's office on the 7/2/34 after having visited
Nanking. On the 8/2/34, he came to this office voluntarily,
and, on being interrogated, explained that the Publishers' Union
Ltd. came into existence on the 3/12/33 and that its object is
to study the problems of sociology and to publish literature
bearing on this subject. The Union has only reached a
preparatory stage and no publications have yet been issued.
Any publication is intended to be similar in character to the
"International Daily Article" which was formerly edited by Mr.
Pao and published by the International Publishing Co., 90 Rue
Marcel Tillot, from August 1, 1933 until October 31, 1933, when
publication was voluntarily suspended. The communistic
literature found at the Union's office, all of which is printed
in foreign languages, was purchased at the American Book & Supply
Co., 410 Szechuen Road.
The circumstances which necessitated police interference
in the Union's affairs are fully understood and acknowledged by
Mr. Pao.
Meanwhile, the literature seized has been sent to the
Special District Court for favour of instructions as to its
disposal. The Court on the 7/2/34 decided to forward it to the
local Kuomintang for examination after which an order for the
final disposal thereof will be given. Mr. Pao has been apprised
of this fact.
D. S.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

参照附件中副督察 Wilcox 关于上述主题的报告，本人须报告称，出版商联合有限公司的一位协理，名为 K. W. Pao (包可華)，住爱多亚路（Rue Victor Emmanuel）38弄6号，于1934年2月7日访问南京后返回联合公司办公室。1934年2月8日，他自愿来到本办公室，并在接受讯问时解释说，出版商联合有限公司成立于1933年12月3日，其宗旨是研究社会学问题并出版与此主题相关的文献。该联合会目前仅处于筹备阶段，尚未发行任何出版物。任何计划出版的刊物性质拟类似于包先生此前编辑、由国际出版公司（地址：马思南路（Rue Marcel Tillot）90号）于1933年8月1日至1933年10月31日期间出版的《国际日报文章》（International Daily Article），该刊于1933年10月31日自愿停刊。在联合公司办公室发现的共产主义文献，全部为外文印刷品，购自四川路410号的美国图书用品公司（American Book & Supply Co.）。

ple
Application is hereby made to the S.S.D. Court for the
disposal of a quantity of communistic literature found
at No. 546 Nanking road at 4.40 p.m. on 5/2/34.

Proceedings
Mr.T.Y.Chang appeared for the Police.
Mr.Chang:-A foreigner reported to the Police that a
room in house No.54 Nanking Road was let to an unknown Chinese some-
time ago and that his man has never returned after having stayed there
for a short time, so the Police went to this room at 4.40pm on the
5.2.34 and they found a number of communistic literature inside.
The Police ask the Court to dispose of them.

Decision
The above literature etc. to be kept by at this court
for the time being and be further disposed of after
being inspected by the Kuomintang Headquarters.

B.J.T.

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
**Communistic Literature found at 54/6 Nanking Road.**

At 4:40 p.m. 3-2-34, a telephone message was received from Mr. Darwin, manager of The Union Press Company, situated on the 1st floor of No. 54/6 Nanking Road, requesting the services of a foreign detective.

The undersigned and C.D.C. 300 attended and ascertained that on 27-11-33, complainant sub let a small office on the 1st floor of the above address to a Chinese at a rental of $35.00 per month.

The Chinese moved furniture into the office on 3-12-33, and professed to be running a small business under the name of "Publisher's Union Ltd."

He used to visit the office at about 12 noon daily and leave again at night.

At about 8 p.m. on 18-12-33, 4 male Chinese all dressed in foreign clothes visited the office and stayed there for about 50 minutes.

After that time they left the office and no one has been seen there since.

On 3-2-34, complainant opened the office with a spare key and found inside a quantity of Communistic books and papers, in Japanese, Chinese and Russian.

From a casual examination of documents and papers it would appear that this office has been occupied by

（左侧手写批注：Office is locked. No information regarding occupants or furnishings. J.R.）

**在南京路54/6号发现共产主义文献。**

1934年2月3日下午4:40，接到位于南京路54/6号一楼的联合印刷公司（The Union Press Company）经理 Darwin 先生的电话留言，请求派遣一名外籍侦探。

署名者及刑事侦缉处警员 300号 到场，查明投诉人于1933年11月27日将上述地址一楼的一间小办公室转租给一名中国人，月租金为35.00美元。

该中国人于1933年12月3日将家具搬入办公室，并声称以“出版商联合有限公司”（Publisher's Union Ltd.）的名义经营小本生意。

他通常每天中午12点左右到办公室，晚上离开。

1933年12月18日晚上8点左右，4名身穿西式服装的中国男子到访办公室，停留了约50分钟。

此后他们离开办公室，自此无人再在那里出现过。

1934年2月3日，投诉人用备用钥匙打开办公室，发现里面有大量日文、中文和俄文的共产主义书籍和文件。
